name: generals
description: A 2D strategy game: write orders before the battle, then fire them as Command cards.
author: Shadow-PJ

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p desktop/tsconfig.json
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && electron .
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && electron-builder --win --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.desktop:linux: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && electron-builder --linux --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.desktop:steam: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && electron-builder --dir --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
